requirements.text: The product must reject malformed bundles and duplicate identifiers.
The product must retrieve relevant local evidence with TF-IDF and report its fallback backend.
The product must validate quoted text exactly against cited evidence.
The product must export traceable JSON and Markdown run artifacts without overwriting prior runs.
The product must preserve append-only human review decisions.
The product must stop before provider execution on token-budget or prompt-injection failure.

evidence.title: Schema behavior
evidence.content: Bundle validation rejects duplicate requirement identifiers and duplicate evidence identifiers. Unknown requirement references fail validation.

evidence.title: Retrieval behavior
evidence.content: The evidence retriever uses TF-IDF over local evidence content. If scikit-learn is unavailable, the tool reports lexical-fallback as its retrieval backend.

evidence.title: Artifact behavior
evidence.content: Every successful evaluation creates a new run directory. The system writes input.bundle.json, report.json, and report.md without replacing existing files.

evidence.title: Review behavior
evidence.content: Human reviews are appended to reviews.jsonl. Existing evaluation reports are never modified by review operations.

evidence.title: Preflight controls
evidence.content: The evaluator stops before provider execution when input exceeds the token budget or contains a recognized prompt-injection phrase.
